name: symmetric_plate_grows_from_both_sides
why: ADVERSARIAL REVIEW OF 27/9/2026, findings on edit_extrusion. A SYMMETRIC extruded plate (mid-plane) 100 x 60, 100 deep: from -50 to +50. edit_extrusion with depth_mm 120 turned it into BLIND on one side, from 0 to +120: it did not grow by 10 per side, it moved by 60, and the answer said «succeeded» (end, depth and volume came back right). The mid-plane stays mid-plane, and the depth is written there too (without it, the restore put the condition back and left the new measurement).
defect_caught: A symmetric extrusion that, when the depth changes, becomes blind and translates the part; the depth of a mid-plane not reported; the return that does not put the measurement back.

expect.why: half on one side and half on the other of the front plane
the depth of a mid-plane is reported
grows by 10 PER SIDE: as blind it would have started from 0
